text: The standard receiver front-end circuit that converts a photodiode's output current into a voltage — trading feedback resistance against bandwidth — is the ___ amplifier.
explanation: The transimpedance amplifier (TIA) sets the current-to-voltage gain via its feedback resistor R_F, where a larger R_F lowers noise but reduces bandwidth (R_F · f_3dB² = A/2πC_T). It is the standard interface between the detector and downstream digital processing.
